howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: Today Tonight and Saturday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind northerly outflow 5 to 15 knots becoming southerly inflow 10 to 15 near noon then becoming northerly outflow 10 to 15 this evening. Wind increasing to northerly outflow 15 to 25 near midnight then diminishing to northerly outflow 10 to 15 near noon Saturday.

hours.reason: Classic Squamish summer thermal: valley heats, draws air up Howe Sound from the south. Multiple models agree, which is a good sign for a thermal-driven day. Solar loading is strong (~567 W/m²) — good thermal driver. Field-calibrated: raw coarse-model wind (~3kt) is scaled up ~2.85x, matching how this thermal typically under-reads on GFS-class models (source: local rider calibration, see README). MSLP backs this up — both the large-scale coast-vs-interior spread (0.7hPa) and the local channel spread (0.4hPa) favor inflow.
hours.summary: Afternoon sea-breeze pattern — builds through the day, fades around sunset.
